unit.title: Addition and Subtraction
unit.blurb: Adding and subtracting two-digit numbers using tens and ones, number bonds to 20 and 100, and solving word problems.
unit.subject: maths

O1.t: Add numbers to 100 using tens and ones.

O2.t: Subtract numbers to 100 and solve word problems.

lesson.t: Add the tens, then the ones

p: If 7 + 3 = 10, then 17 + 3 = 20 and 70 + 30 = 100. Use what you know.
